  df <- df[rownames(df) %in% coldata$AN_clean, ]

source("~/Documents/CellTFusion_paper/user_projects/src/immunoscores.R")

minMax <- function(x) {
  #columns: features
  x = data.matrix(x)
  for(i in 1:ncol(x)){
    x[,i] = (x[,i] - min(x[,i], na.rm = T)) / (max(x[,i], na.rm = T) - min(x[,i], na.rm = T))
  }

  return(x)

}

DEG analysis
```{r}
library(DESeq2)

# Make a new factor where all non-A are merged into "rest"
coldata$group_Arest <- factor(ifelse(coldata$Groups == 1, 1, "rest"))
dds_A <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(round(counts), coldata, design = ~ group_Arest)
dds_A <- DESeq(dds_A)
res_A <- results(dds_A, contrast = c("group_Arest", 1, "rest"))

# Repeat for group B
coldata$group_Brest <- factor(ifelse(coldata$Groups == 2, 2, "rest"))
dds_B <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(round(counts), coldata, design = ~ group_Brest)
dds_B <- DESeq(dds_B)
res_B <- results(dds_B, contrast = c("group_Brest", 2, "rest"))

# Repeat for group C
coldata$group_Crest <- factor(ifelse(coldata$Groups == 4, 4, "rest"))
dds_C <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(round(counts), coldata, design = ~ group_Crest)
dds_C <- DESeq(dds_C)
res_C <- results(dds_C, contrast = c("group_Crest", 4, "rest"))
```

Volcano plots
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# Volcano plot with labels
plot_volcano <- function(res, group_name, lfc_thresh = 1, padj_thresh = 0.05) {
  
  res <- as.data.frame(res)
  
  res$Significance <- "Not Significant"
  res$Significance[res$log2FoldChange >  lfc_thresh & res$padj < padj_thresh] <- "Up in group"
  res$Significance[res$log2FoldChange < -lfc_thresh & res$padj < padj_thresh] <- "Up in rest"
  
  ggplot(res, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = Significance)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Up in group" = "red", 
                                  "Up in rest" = "blue", 
                                  "Not Significant" = "grey")) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_thresh, lfc_thresh), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_thresh), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = subset(res, padj < padj_thresh & abs(log2FoldChange) > lfc_thresh) %>%
        tibble::rownames_to_column("gene"),
      aes(label = gene),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = 15
    ) +
    labs(title = paste0("Volcano Plot: ", group_name, " vs Rest"),
         x = "log2 Fold Change",
         y = "-log10 adjusted p-value") +
    theme_minimal()
}

# Example: three result tables (replace with your actual DEG tables)
# res_A, res_B, res_C from one-vs-rest DESeq2 analyses
p_A <- plot_volcano(as.data.frame(res_A), "Group 1")
p_B <- plot_volcano(as.data.frame(res_B), "Group 2")
p_C <- plot_volcano(as.data.frame(res_C), "Group 4")

# Show them
p_A
p_B
p_C
```

DEG signatures
```{r}
# Function to extract markers for the group
extract_markers <- function(res, lfc_thresh = 1, padj_thresh = 0.05) {
  res <- as.data.frame(res) %>% 
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene")
  
  subset(res, log2FoldChange > lfc_thresh & padj < padj_thresh)$gene
}

# Markers for each group
markers_A <- extract_markers(res_A) # Genes up in Group A
markers_B <- extract_markers(res_B) # Genes up in Group B
markers_C <- extract_markers(res_C) # Genes up in Group C

# Create gene set list
gene_sets <- list(
  GroupA_markers = markers_A,
  GroupB_markers = markers_B,
  GroupC_markers = markers_C
)
```

Function for survival analysis
```{r}
compute.survival.analysis = function(features, survival.data, time_unit, p.value = 0.05) {
  library(survival)
  n_features <- ncol(features)
  significant_combinations <- list() # To store significant feature combinations
  
  # Prepare the data for survival analysis
  data_for_model <- data.frame("time" = survival.data$PFS,
                               "status" = survival.data$PFS_event,
                               "response" = survival.data$R.NR) 
  
  data_for_model$coxHL <- survival.data$deg_group

  # Perform Kaplan-Meier based on coxHL
  km_fit <- survival::survfit(survival::Surv(time, status) ~ coxHL, data = data_for_model)
  
  pval <- survminer::surv_pvalue(km_fit, data = data_for_model)$pval #Performs log-rank test to see whether both survival curves are significantly different
  
  ### Set colors of each curve with the correct order 
  strata_names <- gsub("coxHL=", "", names(km_fit$strata)) 
  legend_labels <- strata_names
  legend.labs = legend_labels

  pdf("Results/SurvPlot_DEG_groups", width = 10, height = 5, onefile = FALSE)
  print(survminer::ggsurvplot(km_fit,
                   data = data_for_model,
                   size = 1,
                   conf.int.style = "step",
                   pval = TRUE,
                   risk.table = TRUE,
                   risk.table.col = "strata",
                   legend.labs = legend.labs,
                   risk.table.height = 0.3,
                   ggtheme = theme_grey(),
                   title = paste0("Cox PH for Surv(time, status) ~ patient groups"),
                   xlab = paste0("Time to death/recurrence/progression (", time_unit, ")")
  ))
  dev.off()

}
```
